newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Prod-Art Tech shares surge 10.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Prod-Art Tech shares surge 10.6 pct.

text.p: Shares of Prod-Art Technology (Holdings) Ltd surged 3.5 cents, or 10.6 percent to HK$0.365 in early Friday trade after the company said its chairman had received several tentative approaches to buy his share of the company.
The chairman, Chan Suk Ping, holds 226.68 million shares representing 35.5 percent of the total issued share capital of the company, Prod-Art said in a statement.
These approaches were very preliminary and Chan had not made any decision on whether he would dispose of part or all of his shares, the chairman told the company.
A total of 12.76 million shares worth HK$4.6 million were traded in first 45 minutes.
